title: A hung test file is ended by its file timeout even on a busy host
description: The merge trial's hung-file case runs pinned to one core shared with a busy loop, so it gets half a core: the hung file still fails by name with its file timeout's own message while the slow file passes, and no wall-clock limit decides the case. With the file timeout disabled the hung file runs on to the trial's overall deadline and the case fails.

steps.name: the hung-file trial case on half a core
steps.run: taskset -c 0 sh -c 'node -e "for(;;);" & busy=$!; node --import tsx tests/helpers/run-tests.ts --test-name-pattern=trial-hung-test-fails-fast tests/trial-merge.test.ts; status=$?; kill $busy; exit $status'
